findings.title: RDP logon to DC-01 from WS-ACCT-07 as jsmith
findings.description: LogonType 10 (RemoteInteractive) from a source/account/time that does not match the RDP allowlist; 4672 shows an administrative session.

findings.technique_name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting
findings.title: Kerberoasting: jsmith requested RC4 tickets for 4 service accounts
findings.description: svc_erp, svc_fileshare, svc_sql, svc_web requested with RC4 (0x17) by one account within 41s; RC4 service tickets can be cracked offline to recover the service account passwords.

findings.title: LSASS accessed by non-system process svchost.exe
findings.description: C:\Users\jsmith\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\svchost.exe opened a handle to lsass.exe with GrantedAccess 0x1410.

findings.title: PsExec-style service 'PSEXESVC' on FS-01 after network logon from WS-ACCT-07
findings.description: A non-allowlisted service was installed within minutes of a Type 3 logon from the same source - remote service execution.

findings.title: Masquerading binary svchost.exe at C:\Users\jsmith\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\svchost.exe
findings.description: svchost.exe is a protected Windows binary name but is running from a user-writable directory.

findings.title: Scheduled task 'MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskUser' runs C:\Users\jsmith\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\svchost.exe
findings.description: Task action points into a user-writable path; task is hidden; trigger LogonTrigger, run level HighestAvailable.

findings.title: winword.exe spawned powershell.exe (Office application spawning a script host)
findings.description: winword.exe is not expected to launch powershell.exe; this is the classic macro-execution lineage.

findings.title: Timestomping on svchost.exe ($SI older than $FN)
findings.description: $SI created 2019-03-19T04:10:11+00:00 is earlier than $FN created 2026-10-19T13:06:30.112000+00:00; the easily-writable $SI times were backdated while $FN retains the true creation time.

findings.title: powershell.exe connected to 198[.]51[.]100[.]25:443 (sync-cdn[.]example)
findings.description: Outbound HTTPS from a script host seconds after macro execution.

findings.technique_name: Event Triggered Execution: WMI Event Subscription
findings.title: WMI subscription 'NorthwindUpdater' runs "C:\Users\jsmith\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\svchost.exe"
findings.description: Permanent WMI filter + CommandLineEventConsumer + binding (fileless persistence).

findings.technique_name: Boot or Logon Autostart: Registry Run Keys
findings.title: Run key 'OneDriveSync' launches C:\Users\jsmith\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\svchost.exe
findings.description: A Run-key autostart points into a user-writable path; legitimate installers register autostarts under Program Files or System32.
